name: OXYGEN DESTROYER
about: The C example OXYGEN DESTROYER rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): 40 Left spinner spins start it (80 the second time, 120 the third). Four stages of 40 s each: the C's hurry-up (20,000,000 draining over the stage, the Left ramp collects it into the pot, the Godzilla target holds it off), the dive (hit the moving sonar ping 3 times: the line names its target), the descent (spin the Left spinner 20 times to lower the device), and Serizawa's choice (the Right ramp: the pot twice over and 25M). Cash the pot out at the right scoop after any stage; the clock or a drain pays a quarter of it.
lost: Every stage has 40 s on every start (PAD-658's round 3: time to do it): the C's hurry-up drained 20,000,000 over 25 s (800,000 a second), and round 2 gave the dive and the descent 30 s and Serizawa's choice 15 s; the sonar ping moved every 3 s (2.3 s, 1.6 s on later starts), now every 10 s.
A new stage is named by the HUD's title (STAGE 2: THE DIVE ...), not by a note over the one the stage before ended on (COLLECTED, GODZILLA FOUND, ON THE SEA BED): that note stays its 3 s.

The value falls on a timer the blocks keep in milliseconds, but the clock the HUD badge shows is whole seconds: a hold-off puts the clock to the next whole second above the value's time (the C counted both from one drain, and a stalled frame drained at most 100 ms).
The Godzilla target has no 250 ms debounce: a ball rattling on the captive ball can use up two hold-offs (the C counted one hit a quarter second); a spinner's spins count each one, as the C's did.

The Left ramp blinks faster as the mode's clock runs down (the blocks' Hurry pattern) and changes colour once a second; the C's blink followed the value itself, every tick, with a flicker in the last 3 s.
No random numbers in blocks: the sonar ping moves in turn (Powerline left, center, right, the Big loop).

The middle counter is the HURRY-UP, then the POT; the C showed a COLLECTED counter beside the super jackpot. Its gauge is one blue, where the C's ten segments went from deep to pale blue, and the spins' note says OXYGEN DESTROYER over 20  -  LEFT SPINNER SPINS TO GO on the first spin, every 5 to go and the last 3, where the C said 24 SPINS TO GO on every spin.

The ending title (GODZILLA IS GONE, THE DIVERS SURFACE, GODZILLA ESCAPES or THE OXYGEN IS GONE) and its total stay up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept them 10 s, with OXYGEN DESTROYER TOTAL under the total.
The cooldown is 15 s on a timer that a new ball clears (the C kept each player's own across balls), and a start from the tab's Start mode now counts toward the 3 a game.
The countdown's 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 callouts are gone (the blocks say only ten seconds and time up).
It plays its own light shows (Oxygen start, Oxygen won, Oxygen lost: the C's fallback shows) on every title, where the C played the game's Playfield wave and Blue fade when the game had them.

The blocks pack keeps its own FINAL WARS ledger in shared variables ('oxygen played', 'oxygen won'), which the blocks FINAL WARS reads: the C FINAL WARS does not read them, and the blocks FINAL WARS does not read the C's ledger.

intro.what: The Oxygen Destroyer canister on the sea bed, beginning to fizz and bubble (one shot)

loop.what: Murky underwater depths: a diver sinks slowly through grey gloom, fish drift past (one continuous shot, dark and even)

collect.what: The device goes off: a column of bubbles erupts from the sea bed (one shot)

won.what: On the sea bed Godzilla's body dissolves to a skeleton, which fades away (one shot)

lost.what: Godzilla surges up out of the sea, roaring (one shot)

dive.what: A diver in a brass helmet climbs down the ship's ladder and sinks into the sea in a ring of bubbles (one shot), 1:27:58.

deep.what: Two divers sink past the rocks into the grey depths, the Oxygen Destroyer canister glinting as it is carried down (one shot), 1:28:16.

canister.what: On the sea bed a diver reaches out across the rocks and draws the gleaming Oxygen Destroyer canister in beside him (one shot), 1:29:34.

found.what: Godzilla's huge dark shape looms through the murky water on the sea bed, an arm raised (one shot), 1:31:30.

choice.what: Dr. Serizawa's face behind the porthole of his diving helmet, still and resolved, as he makes his choice (one shot), 1:32:35.

surface.what: A diver bursts up beside the ship's ladder in a ring of white foam (one shot), 1:31:17.

music.what: Destoroyah's score near the end (bed finder: final 0.820, 1 of 30 blocks untuned)

collect.what: the Oxygen Destroyer starting on the sea bed (the frames: it glows at 1:31:42, its bubbles erupt at 1:31:44)

won.what: Godzilla's last roar as it surfaces (harmonic roar, -15 dB, the loudest in the scene)

lost.what: Godzilla's roar in the Tokyo rampage (the game's own 1954 roar matches 0.86)

dive.what: Water rushing and bubbling as a diver goes over the side, from its onset to where it falls away, 1:27:55.

surface.what: The splash of a diver breaking the surface beside the ship, decaying under the score, 1:31:19.

finale.what: Akira Ifukube's frigate march as the jets and the fleet go after Godzilla, orchestra only, no dialogue (bed finder: seam chroma 0.893, onset 0.443, untuned 0.21, no onsets or bursts, self-check pass), 1:07:25.
